# FacebookAds.my

> Free Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ads audit and Ads Poster service for Malaysian businesses, run by Izzad Iskandar Hidzir — co-founder of Nexova.my and a META creative strategist (Kuala Lumpur).

## What is offered
- A **free Meta ads audit** for Malaysian business owners, content creators, and corporates.
- **2 custom Ads Posters** designed for the business, free, with the audit.
- A **traffic & funnel audit** and **Facebook/Instagram page optimisation tips**.
- Delivered by email within 1–2 business days. No cost, no obligation, no sales call required.
- Prefer to build your own? **nexova.my** is a no-code platform (co-founded by Izzad) to create your own ads, posters, landing pages, and content — free to try.
